schemas_documented: PROCESSOR MANIFEST (UL14), app/legal/processors.json: {"rows": [row, ...]}; keys starting with '_' are comments. Each row has:
id: non-empty string, unique.
name_en: non-empty string that must appear in privacy_policy.md (T7a).
name_ar: non-empty string that must appear in privacy_policy_ar.md; may be Latin; an Arabic proclitic b/l/w may be attached (T7a).
kind: non-empty string; exactly one row has 'retailer', and its modules skip the T7b host check.
personal_data: bool.

module: list of repo-relative FILE paths that exist (a single string is read as a one-element list); backend app/services/...py and/or client SmartCompareApp/...; may be empty only for a recipient with no code site (Railway, Cloudflare).
hosts: list of strings, each matching exactly or as a parent domain; client rows also list the npm package or API identifier the T7c grep looks for.
gate_flag: null or one of the seven review-Q10 flags; set only when the policy names the recipient conditionally on that flag (YouTube); T7a then applies only when the data file has that flag 'on'.

T7a also needs a personal-data row for each of the 13 SPEC_RECIPIENTS_EN. T7c needs, for each CLIENT_PROBES needle (u.expo.dev, @sentry/react-native, expo-apple-authentication, @react-native-google-signin/google-signin, getExpoPushTokenAsync), a row whose hosts lists it and whose SmartCompareApp/ file contains it.

NOT_PERSONAL lives in the test file: app/services/exchange_rate_service.py and app/services/zyte_service.py, each with a reason of 40 or more characters; no module may be both NOT_PERSONAL and in a personal-data row.

FILL-IN DATA FILE (UL9), tests/fixtures/legal_fill_in_u8.json: one JSON object; every key is required; null means not answered or not recorded and is reported by T2; '_'-prefixed keys are comments; any other extra key is an error. Keys:
deletion_variant: '043' | 'old' | null.
territories: 'bahrain' | 'gcc' | null.
counsel_review: bool | null.
d3: 'A' | 'B' | null (T8 treats null as A).
d5: 'A' | 'B' | null.
trade_name: string (may be empty) | null.
minors_clause, openai_store_pinned, inapp_notif_clause: bool | null.

flags: an object naming exactly ENABLE_YOUTUBE_SOURCE, ENABLE_REENGAGEMENT_PUSHES, ENABLE_BONUS_EXPIRY_PUSHES, ENABLE_FEWSHOT_ROTATION, ENABLE_FIRECRAWL, ENABLE_SCRAPEDO, ENABLE_BRIGHTDATA_FALLBACK, each 'on' | 'off' | null (recorded by the orchestrator from a names-only read).
placeholders: {ID: string | null}, one key per <PLACEHOLDER:ID> used in the markdown, the support region source or scripts/legal_variants_u8.json; ID matches [A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*.
